authorization: Owner requested an original broad school module and confirmed the broad scope. Standing paired GitHub and existing ChatGPT publication applies.
goal: Create teacher materials through existing owners with complete original examples, checked keys, age/prerequisite adaptation and honest delivery/evidence status.
protected: 37 canonical skills, interface metadata, existing role/gate map and one Project State
Complete startup, menus, language policy, Learning Mode and workstyle
Pinned upstream, motion/ad methods, providers and exact-copy policies
Plugin identity, scope, audience, assets and default prompts
acceptance: Teacher deliverables enter creation; personal mentoring requires learning intent.
Complete original student inputs, answer keys and open-response criteria.
Age/prerequisite support preserves or explicitly changes the assessed construct.
No unsupported curriculum alignment, educational efficacy or diagnostic claims.
Separate plans, observations and unknown facts; no identifying pupil data in examples.
No commercial source names, URLs, product titles or copied material in published files.
Use existing owners, one review budget and genuinely available document/media tools.
Read back GitHub and saved host, with unreadable files and active-client limits explicit.
review_plan: Existing canonical validator and relevant source tests
Scope preservation, link, answer and completeness checks
Guarded hosted update and exact readback scope
evidence_boundary: Source and content review do not establish active-client retrieval, print/accessibility output or classroom effectiveness.
rollback: Revert only this scoped source change on current main and issue a guarded correction, preserving concurrent work.
